content: From Kansas City hosting the World Cup to old oil wells getting a clean energy makeover, and even Bill Ackman investing in Microsoft's AI future, today's filled with reasons to be optimistic!
Great news: a Gaza aid convoy is preparing to head out from Libya, dengue cases in Singapore have dropped significantly, and an unwanted filly gave her jockey a surprise win!
Ending a very positive day, tensions ease with a truce between Lebanon and Israel, Runway is looking to give Google a run for its money in AI, and a father with no code built an AI baby tracker.

Today's good news includes potential for free energy harvested from the Casimir effect, a delicious-sounding plaice milanese recipe, abstract art getting a mathematical boost, and routine vaccines possibly lowering dementia risk.
Great news today: Fatima Sana set a record in women's cricket, a startup is aiming to manufacture drugs in space, and things are looking up as Israel and Lebanon extend their ceasefire!
